subject: Mechanical Engineering
title: Cam Followers: Riding the Surface
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Cam Followers: Riding the Surface.

hook.text: The follower is the part that touches the cam and carries the motion out.

buildup.text: Flat, roller, and knife-edge followers each interact with the cam differently.

discovery.text: Roller followers reduce wear by rolling instead of sliding on the cam surface.

twist.text: The follower shape changes the effective cam profile — same cam, different motion.

climax.text: Engine valve lifters are cam followers running at thousands of cycles per minute.

punchline.text: The follower rides the cam like a finger reads braille.

quiz.question: Why do roller followers reduce cam wear?
options: They are made from harder material than the cam
They roll instead of sliding, cutting friction on the cam surface
They distribute force over a wider contact area
